title: Offline root-cause repair: forward allowlisted HTTP(S) proxy env into GMGN CLI isolation
objective: Offline-only repair of the GMGN CLI child-process isolation so allowlisted HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY (http/https schemes only) are forwarded into the disposable HOME/CWD sandbox, while parent NODE_OPTIONS are never inherited and child NODE_OPTIONS is fixed to --use-env-proxy --dns-result-order=ipv4first. Expand in-memory safe network failure classification without retaining raw stdout/stderr. Clear pre-existing three-path doctor blockers (absolute input paths, false-positive INLINE_API_CREDENTIAL identifier match, static test PEM block). Do not send any live provider request; do not claim 7d/30d/holdings recovery.
forbidden_actions: Do not invoke GMGN, Helius, Chain.fm, Dune, Dexscreener, Birdeye, RPC, browser, web scraping, or any network/provider request.
Do not print, return, log, commit, fixture, or write proxy URL values, credential values, plaintext addresses, labels, raw stdout/stderr, or full exceptions.
Do not forward ALL_PROXY by default; do not set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0; do not inherit parent NODE_OPTIONS; do not read user HOME GMGN config to bypass explicit credentials.
Do not upgrade gmgn-cli; do not re-run 100 or 1433 wallets; do not claim 7d/30d/holdings live recovery.
Do not write a database, Redis, cache, queue, production system, or perform force-push/reset --hard.
